caption:
That number is from the Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025. The second biggest frustration, at 45%: debugging AI-generated code takes longer. And more developers distrust AI accuracy (46%) than trust it (33%).

Almost-right code is harder than wrong code. Wrong code fails your first test. Almost-right code passes the demo and breaks on the empty cart, the slow network or the second click.

The check I'd run before accepting any AI change:
1. Try it with zero, one and many items.
2. Throttle the network and click twice.
3. Read every line you'd have to explain in review.

Source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, AI section.
